cpmplus.w3animgen.menu.blink.desc: Makes an eye blink by itself in game (open / closed eye groups)
cpmplus.w3animgen.menu.motion.desc: Breathe, float, flap wings, wag tail, pendulum, shake or spin non-stop
cpmplus.w3animgen.menu.color.desc: A slider in the gesture wheel that changes the colour of the selected parts
cpmplus.w3animgen.common.fps.desc: The animation's snapping. More quality = smoother in game and a bigger file.
cpmplus.w3animgen.common.layerCapacity: Warning: the model now has %s animations controlled by skin layers, but only %s free skin layers. CPM will refuse to export it until you free more layers (Skin layers for animations) or turn 'layer controlled' off on some animation.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.title: Make it blink
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.intro: The plugin turns the parts on and off at the right moments; in game the eye blinks by itself.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.random.desc: Makes a long loop (8 to 12 s) with blinks at random-looking moments. CPM has no randomness in game, so the same loop repeats.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.double.desc: Random: some blinks are double. Regular: every blink is double.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.short: A blink of %s s is shorter than one frame at %s frames per second, so it would not show in game.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.done: animation '%s' with %s blink(s) in a %s s loop
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.warn.oneFrame: The blink was shorter than one frame: it lasts one frame now.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.warn.shortLoop: At this quality the random loop could only be %s s long (CPM's 255-frame limit).
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.none: Choose the open eye, the closed eye, or both.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.same: The open eye and the closed eye must be different groups.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.root: '%s' is a main part of the body: CPM can't hide main parts. Choose a group inside it.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.inside: One eye group can't be inside the other one (hiding one would hide both).
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.every: 'Blink every' must be longer than the blink itself.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.length: This loop would be longer than 32.7 seconds, which CPM can't play. Blink more often.
cpmplus.w3animgen.blink.err.frames: This loop would need more than 255 frames, which CPM can't save. Lower the quality or blink more often.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.title: Ready-made motion
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.intro: Pick a motion and the part. The plugin writes the keyframes for you (CPM only plays keyframes, never formulas).
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.pair.auto: Automatic (the part on the other side)
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.cycles.desc: Whole numbers only, so the loop closes without a jump.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.amplitude.desc: Pixels for float / shake, degrees for rotations, fraction of the size for breathe (0.06 = 6%). 0 = use the strength above.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.askLoop: The animation '%s' does not loop. The motion needs a loop to repeat without a jump. Switch it to loop?
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.askReplace: '%s' already has %s keyframes in this animation. Replace them? (they are never mixed)
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.err.noPart: Choose the part that will move.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.err.spec: These settings can't make a motion (check the length: up to 32.7 s, and the speed).
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.err.rootScale: CPM doesn't let you change the size of the main parts; choose a part inside it.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.err.pairInside: The other wing can't be the same part, or inside it.
cpmplus.w3animgen.motion.err.hasKeys: '%s' already has keyframes on this channel in that animation.
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.askPivot: The spin centre of '%s' is %s px away from the middle of the part: it will spin crooked. Create a spin group in the centre? (the part's contents go into a new group whose pivot is in the middle; nothing moves)
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.askTilt: '%s' rests tilted: the spin would turn around the parent's axis. Create a spin group in the centre? (a new group inside it spins straight)
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.makeGroup: Create spin group in the centre
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.tooFast: The part '%s' spins too fast for the current quality in animation '%s' (%s degrees between frames; CPM may turn it backwards). Raise the snapping to %s.
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.tooFastNoFix: The part '%s' spins too fast in animation '%s' (%s degrees between frames; CPM may turn it backwards). Use fewer turns or a longer animation.
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.tooFastDialog: The part '%s' spins too fast for the current quality (%s degrees between frames). Raise the snapping to %s.
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.tooFastDialogNoFi: The part '%s' spins too fast (%s degrees between frames) and no quality fits CPM's 255-frame limit. Use fewer turns or a longer animation.
cpmplus.w3animgen.spin.consequence: CPM turns in a straight line between frames, always the short way: big steps can play backwards in game.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.title: Make a colour slider
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.name: Name
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.smooth.desc: Off: the slider jumps from one colour to the next. On: the colours blend.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.hint: In game it becomes a slider in the gesture wheel.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.askRecolor: These parts don't take colour in game: %s. Turn 'Recolor' on for them? (white: the texture stays the same until you move the slider)
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.err.noParts: Select the parts (groups inside the body parts) that will change colour, then try again.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.err.root: '%s' is a main part of the body: choose a group inside it.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.err.recolor: These parts don't take colour in game: %s. Turn 'Recolor' on for them first.
cpmplus.w3animgen.color.err.noCube: These parts have no cube that can take colour (rotated cubes become separate parts in CPM): %s.
